The aim of this course is to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of strategic positioning and the steps involved in the process. Learners will also gain an understanding of the Ansoff Matrix and Bowman's Strategic Clock, as well as an understanding of strategic options, product life cycle, and its goals. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: Strategic positioning is a critical component of any business strategy. It involves identifying and defining the unique characteristics and competitive advantages of a company, product, or service, and positioning it in the market to achieve its goals. This course will provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of strategic positioning, including the steps involved in the process, the Ansoff Matrix, Bowman's Strategic Clock, strategic options, product life cycle, and its goals.
